description: This file defines the interface and functions related to a vector storage system in Go, including encoding/decoding embeddings, similarity metrics, and vector search functionalities.

methods.name: parseDistanceMetric
methods.description: Parses a string to determine the vector distance metric, defaulting to cosine.

methods.name: encodeEmbedding
methods.description: Encodes a float32 vector into a byte slice using little-endian format.

methods.name: decodeEmbedding
methods.description: Decodes a byte slice into a float32 vector.

methods.name: ensureVectorPayload
methods.description: Validates that a VectorRecord has all necessary fields populated.

methods.name: normalizeMetadata
methods.description: Returns a non-nil map of metadata, defaulting to an empty map if input is nil.

methods.name: cosineSimilarity
methods.description: Calculates the cosine similarity between two vectors.

methods.name: dotProduct
methods.description: Computes the dot product of two vectors.

methods.name: l2Distance
methods.description: Calculates the L2 (Euclidean) distance between two vectors.

methods.name: computeSimilarity
methods.description: Computes similarity and distance scores based on the specified metric.

methods.name: sortAndLimit
methods.description: Sorts search results based on scores and distances, limiting to topK results.

methods.name: metadataMatchesFilters
methods.description: Checks if metadata matches a set of filter criteria.
